name: marketdesk
description: Read-only Marketdesk tools. Each tool calls the same HTTP API as the workspaces; MCP does not host separate business logic.

environment.MARKETDESK_API: Base URL of the Marketdesk HTTP API (default http://127.0.0.1:8130)
environment.MARKETDESK_TOKEN: Bearer token forwarded to the HTTP API. Never forwarded to an upstream model or third party.

tools.name: query_operational_data
tools.description: Run an approved operational analytics pattern.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search catalog listings with an optional category filter.

tools.name: get_price_references
tools.description: Inspect price observations and the comparison range for a product.

tools.name: get_finding
tools.description: Read a listing or sourcing finding by id.

tools.name: get_draft_status
tools.description: Read draft state and the current revision hash.
